records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Comparable sales increased 6.1% for the quarter, with increases across all of our customer channels, driven by higher average order values, our digital transformation, and our brand repositioning.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Stores that have been open for at least 13 months are included in comparable sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Dollars per transaction was the primary driver of our sales increase and was attributable to our reduced reliance on promotions, a historically low-level of clearance inventory and a shift in merchandise mix to higher-price items, such as tailored clothing.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the second quarter of fiscal 2022, our gross margin rate, inclusive of occupancy costs, was 52.1% as compared to a gross margin rate of 51.7% for second quarter of fiscal 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At July 30, 2022, we continued to provide a valuation allowance of $2.4 million, primarily against certain state and foreign net operating losses ("NOLs").
